The '''Treaty of Generis''' was signed between [[Mon Mothma/Legends|Mon Mothma]], representing the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] and the leadership of the [[Atrivis Resistance Group/Legends|Atrivis Resistance Group]]. It made the ARG formally part of the Rebel Alliance; consequently, an [[Outer Rim Communications Center]] was established on [[Generis/Legends|Generis]], with a starfighter complement for protection. In addition, the Alliance also sent several dozen [[Alliance Special Forces/Legends|Alliance Special Forces]] officers to train up the Atrivis resistance. The Treaty led to an increased flow of new weapons and equipment to the [[Atrivis sector/Legends|Atrivis sector]], in return for becoming a prime supplier of foodstuffs to the wider Rebellion. Within six months, the ARG had transformed into the [[Atrivis Sector Force]].
